intro: The Gum magnetic chalkboard label is a little tool with big convenience. Designed to be reusable and secure, it keeps your lists, reminders, and ideas visible—so you never miss a thing.

features.title: One label, endless possibilities
features.text: From grocery lists to reminders, this versatile label helps you stay organised in the kitchen, office, or even a child’s room.

features.title: Stays put with a strong magnetic back
features.text: Designed to hold firmly onto any metal surface, so your notes, lists, and reminders stay exactly where you need them.

features.title: Write, erase, and reuse effortlessly
features.text: Easily wipe it clean and update your notes anytime—so you can stay flexible and organised without wasting paper.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Gum Magnetic Chalkboard Label
